Rust logged sensor completion without per-file counts. Java rows without a scanner run remain unmeasured on the reference side.
Missing size metrics locate possible omissions; they do not establish the cause. Known generated bundle exclusions are accounted for separately.

Exact-scope primary totals include only findings on comparable paths and active, implemented rules with matching declared parameters. They do not certify messages, secondary positions, hotspots, aggregate duplication, gates, or commercial analyzers.
